_comment: Baseline readiness snapshot as of 2026-04-23. CI gate (scripts/ci/verify_launchops_readiness_baseline.sh) compares .launchops/readiness.json against this file. Regression rules: scan_score may not drop by more than READINESS_TOLERANCE (default 0.5) from the baselined scan_score, each module may not drop by more than READINESS_MODULE_TOLERANCE (default 1.0) from its baselined score, and status may not regress (non-BLOCKED -> BLOCKED). Silent improvements (score climbs, status unblocks, new modules appear) emit advisory warnings and are locked in with UPDATE_BASELINE=1 in the same PR. Optional strict mode X3_REQUIRE_READINESS_UNBLOCKED=1 fails on any BLOCKED status regardless of baseline; this is OFF until the mainnet go-live PR flips it on.
accepted_reason: Canonical readiness is 60.63 / BLOCKED per mainnet scorecard 2026-04-22 (canonical_readiness 20.8% hard-gate view). Baselined as BLOCKED to match the scorecard; the gate enforces no regression, not unblocked status. Flip to strict once Wave 0 workspace burn-down + red_flags burn-down complete.
